name: casefile
description: Casefile for agents: the skill and the MCP connector (sign-in through OAuth, no token in the plugin); connect to an installation, recover from 401, keep the case and watch the journal.

casefile_url.title: Casefile MCP address
casefile_url.description: Address of the Casefile MCP server, for example http://127.0.0.1:8100/mcp for an installation on this machine or https://casefile.example.com/mcp for a server. No token here: the agent signs in through OAuth.
